name: EmailIdea SMTP Mailer
author: Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt Ltd

sections.description:
EmailIdea SMTP Mailer helps WordPress websites enhance and optimize their email delivery. Unlike generic SMTP plugins, EmailIdea provides:

  • API-based email delivery: Faster and more reliable than traditional SMTP.
  • SaaS connectivity: Seamless integration with the EmailIdea ecosystem.
  • Advanced reporting & logs: Track every email sent from your site.

On many hosting environments, emails are sent using the default PHP mail() function. While this method works in basic setups, it sometimes does not provide the best deliverability performance and can result in emails being flagged as not reaching the inbox.

With EmailIdea, you can send all your WordPress emails — including admin notifications, contact form submissions, and WooCommerce order emails — through a secure and reliable SMTP service.

After registering at EmailIdea, you’ll receive:
– SMTP Host
– SMTP Port
– SMTP Username
– SMTP Password

Enter these details in the plugin settings, and your site will start sending emails securely and reliably.

Video Tutorial How to Use EmailIdea SMTP Mailer

Company & Ownership

EmailIdea is a product of Konceptwise Digital Media Pvt Ltd.
The plugin is officially developed and maintained by the EmailIdea team.
Official website: https://emailidea.biz/

External Services

This plugin relies on the EmailIdea SMTP service for email delivery. Use of this service is subject to the following:
* EmailIdea Terms of Service
* EmailIdea Privacy Policy

Features

  • API-based email delivery for maximum reliability
  • SaaS connectivity with EmailIdea platform
  • Advanced reporting and email logs
  • Easy setup via WordPress admin panel
  • Secure SMTP authentication
  • Supports SSL/TLS encryption
  • Works with all WordPress emails (core, plugins, themes)
  • Test email option to verify configuration
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/emailidea-smtp-mailer/ directory, or install via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → EmailIdea SMTP Mailer.
  4. Enter your SMTP credentials (Host, Port, Username, Password).
  5. Save changes and send a test email to confirm setup.
sections.faq:
Why do I need this plugin?

WordPress’s default mail function is unreliable. This plugin ensures your emails are delivered using EmailIdea’s SMTP servers.

Do I need an EmailIdea account?

Yes. You must register at EmailIdea to obtain SMTP credentials.

Will this work with WooCommerce and other plugins?

Yes. Any email sent via WordPress will be routed through EmailIdea SMTP.
